title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise along with the underlying pattern. Consider how using only part of the validation set might affect the model's ability to generalize.

title: Role of Validation Set
text: The validation set is used to evaluate the model's performance on unseen data. Think about how using only half of it might impact the evaluation process.

title: Impact on Model Evaluation
text: If we use only half of the validation set, does it provide a complete picture of the model's performance?
